evidence.reason: The sibling `moved` is enqueued with `AT` (2026-10-30T00:00:00Z) at line 124 and is evaluated at line 130 on 2026-11-10, so the 24-hour age guard makes it ineligible before shared family quarantine history is consulted. The assertion can therefore pass for the wrong reason and does not test the named shared-quarantine behavior. The fix is test-only: enqueue the sibling just before the sixth failure, check at the quarantine/cooldown boundary, and include an unquarantined control sibling.
